title: [Audit] Kibana saved-object activity by actor
description: Kibana reads and changes of named objects, newest first, with each object’s name, type and space; capped at the newest 1,000 in range. Routine page loads and this suite’s own activity are left out; real changes always stay.
esql: SET unmapped_fields="nullify"; FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE service.name == "serverless-kibana" | WHERE (kibana.saved_object.type IS NOT NULL OR event.action LIKE "ml_*" OR event.action LIKE "workflow_*" OR event.action LIKE "agent_builder_*" OR event.action LIKE "product_documentation_*" OR event.action == "secret_create") | WHERE event.action IS NULL OR NOT (event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time","space_get","space_find") OR (event.action == "http_request" AND url.original IS NOT NULL AND url.original RLIKE "https?://[^/]+(/s/[^/]+)?/((internal|translations|app)/.*|api/content_management/rpc/(get|search|mget|bulkGet).*|bootstrap(-anonymous)?[.]js.*|api/(core|licensing|banners|ui_counters)/.*|api/spaces/space([?].*)?)|https?://[^/]+(/s/[^/]+)?/api/(saved_objects/(_import|_export)|[^?]*/(elastic_)?cloud-audit-).*") OR (kibana.saved_object.type IS NOT NULL AND ((event.action == "saved_object_get" AND kibana.saved_object.type IN ("config","config-global")) OR (event.action == "saved_object_find" AND kibana.saved_object.type == "index-pattern"))) OR (kibana.saved_object.id IS NOT NULL AND (kibana.saved_object.id LIKE "cloud-audit-*" OR kibana.saved_object.id LIKE "elastic_cloud-audit-*") AND (event.action IN ("saved_object_get","saved_object_resolve","saved_object_find") OR kibana.session.id IS NULL))) | SORT @timestamp DESC | LIMIT 1000 | EVAL actor = COALESCE(user.email, api_key.name, user.name, "<anonymous>"), actor_kind = CASE(user.email IS NOT NULL, "human", "service") | EVAL verb = CASE(event.action LIKE "*_execution_cancel", "cancel", event.action LIKE "*_run_soon", "run", event.action LIKE "*_run", "run", event.action LIKE "*_test", "test", event.action LIKE "*_enable", "enable", event.action LIKE "*_disable", "disable", event.action LIKE "ml_put_*", "create", event.action LIKE "ml_open_*", "open", event.action LIKE "ml_start_*", "start", event.action LIKE "*point_in_time", "pit", event.action LIKE "*_create*", "create", event.action LIKE "*_update*", "update", event.action LIKE "*_delete", "delete", event.action LIKE "*_find", "find", event.action LIKE "*_get", "get", event.action LIKE "*_resolve", "resolve", "other") | GROK body.text """\[(?:id|workflowId)=%{DATA:g_id}(?:,|\])""" | GROK body.text """\[name=%{GREEDYDATA:g_name}\]""" | GROK body.text """\[executionId=%{DATA:g_exec}\]""" | GROK body.text """case id: %{NOTSPACE:g_case}""" | GROK body.text """(?:job|datafeed) %{NOTSPACE:g_ml}""" | EVAL obj_type = CASE(kibana.saved_object.type IS NOT NULL, kibana.saved_object.type, event.action LIKE "ml_*ad_job", "ml-job", event.action LIKE "ml_*ad_datafeed", "ml-datafeed", event.action LIKE "workflow_execution_*", "workflow-execution", event.action LIKE "workflow_*", "workflow", event.action LIKE "agent_builder_agent_*", "agent-builder-agent", event.action LIKE "agent_builder_tool_*", "agent-builder-tool", event.action LIKE "product_documentation_*", "product-documentation", event.action == "secret_create", "secret", event.action IS NULL, "unclassified", REPLACE(event.action, "_(create|update|delete|enable|disable|run|run_soon|test|cancel)$", "")) | EVAL obj_name = COALESCE(kibana.saved_object.name, g_name, g_id, kibana.saved_object.id, g_case, g_ml, g_exec, body.text) | KEEP @timestamp, actor, verb, obj_type, obj_name, kibana.space.id, body.text | EVAL obj_name = CASE(obj_type == "usage-counter", REPLACE(obj_name, "^([^:]+):(.+):([^:]+):[^:]+:([0-9]{4})([0-9]{2})([0-9]{2})$", "$2 ($1 $3 counter, $4-$5-$6)"), obj_type == "config", CONCAT("Advanced settings ", obj_name), obj_type == "config-global", CONCAT("Global settings ", obj_name), obj_name) | EVAL actor = CASE((LENGTH(actor) == 20 AND actor RLIKE "[-_A-Za-z0-9]{20}" AND NOT actor RLIKE "[0-9]{20}"), CONCAT(LEFT(actor, 5), "… · Cloud API key"), actor) | RENAME @timestamp AS Time, actor AS Identity, verb AS Operation, obj_type AS `Object type`, obj_name AS Object, kibana.space.id AS Space, body.text AS Message
